package.description: Real-Time Squarified Treemap RAM Visualizer for Windows Desktop.

en-US.description: Real-Time Squarified Treemap RAM Visualizer for Windows Desktop.
en-US.longDescription: RAMView is a modern Windows desktop utility that visualizes live system RAM usage as small, translucent, floating boxes — one box per process, sized proportionally to that process's Working Set physical memory consumption, arranged via a squarified treemap layout.
en-US.name: RAMView
